mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.2% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing inflationary pressure and increasing the likelihood of future monetary easing, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 4.2% over a 3-month window, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1,650,000 units over the past two months indicates weakening consumer demand for durable goods and residential investment, which signals a contraction in aggregate demand and triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1,650.0, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 101.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity and declining supply-side capacity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and increases the probability of recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 101.0 for two months, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based collapse in consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% combined with a decline in industrial production below 101.0 signals a tightening monetary policy during a weakening supply environment, increasing the risk of stagflation and triggering negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% and INDPRO falls below 101.0, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4.2% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50,000 jobs signals a labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE exceeds 4.2% and PAYEMS falls below 50,000, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 620,000 million dollars combined with a drop in GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening aggregate demand environment, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls below 620,000 and GDPC1 drops below 19,800, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against a zero mean, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
